say:1:1033612001:1.text: Not anymore. I should've already headed straight back to report to the Dusk Patrollers.
say:1:1033612001:1.source_cn: 不，执勤任务已经结束，我本该立刻回到薄暮巡游队报道。
say:1:1033612001:1.male: Not anymore. I should've already headed straight back to report to the Dusk Patrollers.
say:1:1033612001:1.female: Not anymore. I should've already headed straight back to report to the Dusk Patrollers.

say:2:1033612002:1.text: But check out that valley up ahead, with those gorgeous orchids in full bloom—it's a sight to behold.
say:2:1033612002:1.source_cn: 但您看，前方的山谷，如今平和盛放的幽兰花多么美丽。
say:2:1033612002:1.male: But check out that valley up ahead, with those gorgeous orchids in full bloom—it's a sight to behold.
say:2:1033612002:1.female: But check out that valley up ahead, with those gorgeous orchids in full bloom—it's a sight to behold.

say:3:1033612003:1.text: After everyone pitched in so much effort, seeing the forest bounce back like this makes it all worthwhile.
say:3:1033612003:1.source_cn: 在大家付出那么多努力后，能让丛林重新恢复现在的生机，那...
say:3:1033612003:1.male: After everyone pitched in so much effort, seeing the forest bounce back like this makes it all worthwhile.
say:3:1033612003:1.female: After everyone pitched in so much effort, seeing the forest bounce back like this makes it all worthwhile.

say:4:1033612004:1.text: Even if it's just for a little while, I want to soak in the current view. This is all thanks to your hard work, Captain Lyca, and everyone else.
say:4:1033612004:1.source_cn: 哪怕只有一会儿，我想多享受一下现在的风景，这是您和莱卡...
say:4:1033612004:1.male: Even if it's just for a little while, I want to soak in the current view. This is all thanks to your hard work, Captain Lyca, and everyone else.
say:4:1033612004:1.female: Even if it's just for a little while, I want to soak in the current view. This is all thanks to your hard work, Captain Lyca, and everyone else.

say:5:1033612005:1.text: I hope Captain Lyca will understand if I enjoy this view for just a bit longer.
say:5:1033612005:1.source_cn: 希望莱卡队长能够谅解。
